fields.name: Sensormatic IDX-4000 RFID Industrial Proximity Guardian & Multilingual WhatsApp Alert MAS
fields.description: Cyber-Physical Multi-Agent System for Industrial RFID. Ingests raw tag reads from Sensormatic IDX-4000 edge readers, computes deterministic radial kinematic proximity over Keonn Advan-CP1 near-field antennas (< 1ms via Google CEL), performs on-the-fly multilingual cognitive translation via local SLM (Ollama qwen2.5:1.5b), and dispatches deduplicated WhatsApp notifications with anti-spam cooldown.
